        with open(os.path.join(working_dir, f"{dataset}_meta.pkl"), "rb") as handle:
            metadata = pickle.load(handle)
        state = torch.load(checkpoint_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        transition_keys = sorted(
            key for key in state if key.startswith("transition_")
        )
        if metadata.get("architecture") != "sasrec_recent_fusion_v1":
            raise RuntimeError("Reassess calibration prerequisites for this architecture")
        if transition_keys or callable(getattr(exported_class, "score_components", None)):

        if "transition_evidence" in exported_source:
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected exported transition scorer")

                digest.update(chunk)

            "architecture": metadata["architecture"],
            "checkpoint_sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
            "transition_state_keys": transition_keys,
            "score_components_available": False,
